intro: Apollo College of Physiotherapy and Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences both sit in Hyderabad, and this page compares their recorded Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in 2026.

Apollo College of Physiotherapy vs Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences is not a single winner. Apollo College of Physiotherapy is recorded as a private institute, while Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences is public. Pick the campus that matches the programme you want, the fee you can pay, and the admission test you will take.
